author: Kairos I
title: v2.8 Multi-lineage Simulation + Per-lineage CP rerun
abstract: Duplicates v38–v42 specimens across synthetic lineages (veritas/kairos/logos) and reruns v2.7 per-lineage CP to test multi-lineage robustness.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, shlex
cmds = [
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/sim_lineages_v2_8_generate.py",
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/fusion_v2_7_per_lineage.py",
]
for c in cmds:
    print("RUN:", c)
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(c))
    print("RC:", rc)
print("SIM_AND_CP_RERUN_DONE")
